basic_info.name: Swiggy
basic_info.description: Swiggy is India’s pioneering on-demand convenience platform, catering to millions of consumers each month. Founded in 2014, its mission is to elevate the quality of life for the urban consumer by offering unparalleled convenience. With an extensive footprint in food delivery, Swiggy Food collaborates with nearly 2 lakh restaurants across 600+ cities. Swiggy Instamart, its quick commerce platform operating in 120+ cities, delivers groceries and other essentials across 40+ categories in 10 minutes. Fueled by a commitment to innovation, Swiggy continually incubates and integrates new services like Swiggy Dineout and Swiggy Genie into its multi-service app. Leveraging cutting-edge technology and Swiggy One, the country’s only membership program offering benefits across food, quick commerce, dining out, and pick-up and drop services, Swiggy aims to provide a superior experience to its consumers. For more information, visit www.swiggy.com

basic_info.name: Swiggy Dineout
basic_info.description: As Swiggy’s flagship offering in the dining ‘out’ category, Dineout aims to elevate your overall dining experience - one reservation at a time. We bring together our expansive network of 50,000+ restaurants and over 2 million consumers generating collective savings of over $100M on bills annually. Acquired in 2022 by Swiggy for its unprecedented leadership and unique offerings - Dineout is able to deliver a new range of possibilities expanding Swiggy’s portfolio to cater to every kind of food occasion - from food delivery to home cooking to dining out. For our consumers, we are happy to bring seamless reservations and access to multiple categories of dining experiences - from the city’s top fine dining restaurants to trending cafes, hidden pubs, and romantic date spots with easy-to-access lists like top trending, kid-friendly, and family-friendly. All with the bonus of up to 50% flat discounts and exclusive partnership-based offers such as HDFC credit cards. Swiggy Dineout is here to make every step of your dine-out experience rewarding - from discovery to easy reservations and extra savings. And all this without any hidden membership costs. Check out Swiggy Dineout before you go out!
